safety.note: These are public-market-data and simulated/research checks, not live trading or profitability evidence.

freqtrade.market: OKX public USDT-settled linear swaps recognized by Freqtrade
freqtrade.strategy: upstream SampleStrategy with short rules enabled
scope_limits: No dated futures, inverse contracts or other settlement currencies
No exchange credentials and no order endpoint
Short observation window; zero trades is not a performance result

octobot.mode: public OKX feed plus simulator startup probe
scope_limits: The OctoBot trader was explicitly disabled; the simulator was enabled
Candle delivery does not prove signal generation, fills or strategy coverage
Telegram initialization was intentionally omitted and is not a market-data failure

jesse.strategy: fixed 50 USDT long-only smoke strategy; EMA20/EMA50 and RSI14; 1% stop/target
scope_limits: This validates Jesse core ingestion and research execution, not Jesse live/paper
The strategy is a test harness, not a supplied profitable strategy
Slippage, funding and live fill behavior are not represented
